entries.name: portrait_filters.metallib
entries.note: Portrait filters: the depth-driven blur exists (springboard/render/src/depth_blur.rs, depth_blur::tests). The portrait lighting kernels are missing, and the depth or matte input comes from the caller. role inferred from the owning path; the metallib was not disassembled Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Shader pass: portrait relighting from depth (Lambert model in springboard/render/src/portrait_lighting.rs, relight); not the reference curves.

entries.name: Photogrammetry_Matching_Kernels.metallib
entries.role: 3D scene / RealityKit / USD rendering and geometry processing shaders
entries.note: Corner detection, binary descriptors and descriptor matching now exist on the CPU in kernel_feature_match.rs beside the stereo block matcher. Scale and rotation invariance, geometric verification and reconstruction are not built. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: feature detection and matching kernels in springboard/render/src/kernel_feature_match.rs (FAST-style segment-test corners with non-maximum suppression, 256-bit BRIEF-style descriptors from a fixed hash-derived pair pattern, Hamming distance, brute-force matching with ratio test and cross-check), tests kernel_feature_match::tests; dense two-view matching stays in stereo.rs. This is the detection and matching stage only, not a photogrammetry reconstruction; no GLSL file was written. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.

entries.name: ProcessAccelerate.metallib
entries.role: Computer-vision, computational photography or ML image processing shaders
entries.note: Encoder-side analysis, deinterlace, temporal denoise, flow warp and pyramid kernels now exist on the CPU in kernel_video_filters.rs, next to block_motion.rs, frame_interp.rs and the shutter blend and deghost in temporal_upscale.rs. There is no GPU video pipeline yet. Verified on the midget with BifrOSt 0.10.16 (os_verify).
entries.ready_note: Ready: video-processing kernels in springboard/render/src/kernel_video_filters.rs (SAD, 4x4 Hadamard SATD, 2x luma downscale, histogram scene-cut score, edge-directed deinterlace, motion-adaptive temporal denoise, flow warp, Gaussian pyramid step), tests kernel_video_filters::tests. Motion search is block_motion.rs, interpolation frame_interp.rs, shutter blend and median deghost temporal_upscale.rs; no GLSL file was written. Clean-room: written from public algorithm descriptions for the job this library serves; the metallib was not disassembled or compared.
